name: MKJB AI SEO FAQ Schema
author: MikukJubu

sections.description:
MKJB AI SEO FAQ Schema is a beginner-friendly WordPress plugin that helps you create SEO-optimized FAQ sections with valid schema markup – automatically.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered FAQ Generation – Automatically generate FAQ pairs from your post content using OpenAI
  • 3 Input Modes – Auto Generate (AI), Paste Existing FAQs, or Manual Input
  • JSON-LD Schema – Valid FAQPage schema injected into page <head> automatically
  • FAQ Quality Analyzer v2 – 12-point SEO analysis with a 100-point scoring system
  • Target Keyword Analysis – SEO keyword optimization checks for questions and answers
  • 3 Display Styles – Minimal, Card, or Accordion (configurable per block)
  • Custom AI Prompt – Customize the prompt sent to OpenAI for FAQ generation
  • Model Selection – Choose from multiple OpenAI models (gpt-4o-mini to o3)
  • Remove All FAQs – Quickly clear all FAQ entries with a single button
  • No Build Tools – Drop into /wp-content/plugins/ and activate. Zero npm, zero React.

How It Works

  1. Add the MKJB AI SEO FAQ Schema block to any post or page
  2. Choose a mode: Auto Generate, Paste FAQs, or Manual Input
  3. The plugin automatically generates valid JSON-LD FAQPage schema
  4. Schema is injected into the page <head> when published
  5. FAQ content is displayed visually on the frontend

Security

  • API key stored server-side, never exposed to the browser
  • Server-side REST API calls with nonce verification
  • Rate limiting: 10 requests per minute per user
  • All input sanitized, all output escaped

External services

This plugin connects to the OpenAI API (api.openai.com) to generate FAQ content and extract target keywords.
It sends the text content of your WordPress post/page and your custom prompt when you click the “Generate FAQ” or “Auto Detect” buttons.
The data is sent to OpenAI’s servers to process the generative AI output.
This service is provided by OpenAI:

sections.installation:
1. Upload the mkjb-ai-seo-faq-schema folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Go to Settings > MKJB AI SEO FAQ Schema to enter your OpenAI API key
  4. Add the block to any post or page using the block inserter
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Only for the Auto Generate mode (Tab 1) and AI keyword extraction. The “I Have FAQ” and “Manual Input” modes work without any API key.

Is the schema valid for Google?

Yes! The plugin generates schema.org FAQPage JSON-LD markup that follows Google’s structured data guidelines.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

The FAQ schema and visual display will stop appearing on your pages. However, your FAQ data is preserved in the database and will be restored when you reactivate.

What happens if I delete the plugin?

All plugin settings (API key, model, prompt, FAQ count, style) are removed from the database. FAQ content stored in your posts is preserved.

Can I customize the AI prompt?

Yes! Go to Settings > MKJB AI SEO FAQ Schema and edit the Custom AI Prompt field. Use {count} as a placeholder for the number of FAQs.

How is the FAQ Quality score calculated?

The analyzer checks 12 criteria across 3 categories: Basic (40 pts), Direct Answer/SEO (30 pts), and Keyword SEO (30 pts). The score is always shown out of 100.

1.2.1

  • Fixed: Block not appearing in WordPress block inserter (/faq search)
  • Fixed: Block category changed from deprecated ‘common’ to ‘text’
  • Fixed: Added apiVersion 2 for proper useBlockProps support
  • Fixed: Removed deprecated wp-editor dependency
  • Fixed: Removed all non-ASCII characters from JS to prevent encoding issues
  • Fixed: Updated deprecated isPrimary/isSecondary Button props to variant API
  • Added: Block supports configuration (html: false, multiple: true)
  • Improved: Version bump for cache busting

1.2.0

  • Added: “Remove All FAQs” button in I Have FAQ and Manual Input tabs
  • Added: Score always displayed as X/100 (normalized from 70 when keyword not set)
  • Added: First-person usage detection (We/Our/Us/My) in Quality Analyzer
  • Added: Sentence length check based on 20-word limit
  • Changed: Answer length requirements updated to 100-1000 characters
  • Changed: FAQ questions rendered as H3 for proper heading hierarchy
  • Changed: Accordion questions use H3 inside summary element
  • Changed: Default AI prompt updated for plain text formatting
  • Fixed: Browser cache preventing updated JS/CSS from loading (version bump)
  • Improved: Quality Analyzer v2 rules aligned with SEO/GEO prompt

1.1.0

  • Added: OpenAI model selection (gpt-4o-mini, gpt-5-nano, gpt-5-mini, gpt-5, o3-mini, o3)
  • Added: Custom AI prompt with {count} placeholder
  • Added: FAQ Quality Analyzer v2 with 100-point scoring system
  • Added: Target keyword input with AI auto-detect
  • Added: FAQ title display option (H2/H3/H4)
  • Added: Delete API Key button
  • Added: Rate limiting (10 req/min/user)
  • Added: Nested block support for schema injection
  • Fixed: API key overwrite bug when saving other settings
  • Fixed: Schema null output on empty FAQs
  • Fixed: CSS double-loading on frontend
  • Fixed: has_block() parameter error
  • Improved: Modern CSS design with custom properties
  • Improved: Security hardening for public distribution

1.0.0

  • Initial release
